## Services & Products Offered
1. **Modern False Ceiling:** Gypsum & PVC false ceilings with ambient LED cove lighting and spotlights.
2. **Gypsum Work:** Custom wall mouldings, partitions, cornices, and architectural ceiling details.
3. **PVC Wall & Ceiling Paneling (Pelling):** Durable, moisture-resistant luxury PVC fluted panels, UV marble sheets, and gold trims.
4. **Customized Media Walls & Bed Back Walls:** Bespoke TV media units with wooden slats, WPC louvers, marble sheets, and concealed lighting.
5. **Imported Wallpapers:** Designer 3D mural and textured luxury wallpapers.
6. **Waterproof Vinyl Flooring (LVT):** Scratch-resistant, wood-look luxury vinyl plank flooring.
7. **Luxury Artificial Grass:** High-density, UV-resistant artificial turf rolls for balconies, terraces, lawns, and green feature walls.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Facts)
- **Who is the best interior designer in Gujranwala for turnkey renovation?** H-S Interiors delivers 3D design to complete on-site installation with an in-house team, transparent itemised quotes, and zero hidden charges.
- **Do you offer free on-site measurements?** Yes, free on-site measurements, laser site visits, and physical material sample consultations are available across Gujranwala via WhatsApp (+92 324 9707424).
- **How long does installation take?** Customized media walls, vinyl flooring, wallpapers, and artificial grass typically take 1–3 days; full-room false ceilings and PVC paneling take 3–7 days.
